gloss: no; whether or not; nay, rather

definitions.gloss: whether or not, yes or no
definitions.explanation: Used to present an alternative or question about whether something is so or not. Often appears in compound expressions.
Used to correct or upgrade a previous statement, similar to 'nay' or 'or rather' in English. Literary.

examples.japanese: ⟦{賛否|さんぴ}→賛否：14233_sanpi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かれた→分かれる：10976_wakareru⟧。
examples.english: Opinions were divided between for and against.

examples.japanese: ⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧{否|いな}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{本人|ほんにん}→本人：03627_honnin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧だ。
examples.english: Whether or not to participate is up to the individual.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{提案|ていあん}→提案：03536_teian⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{入|い}れる→受け入れる：05755_ukeireru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧{否|いな}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{今後|こんご}→今後：02808_kongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決定|けってい}される→決定する：21022_ketteisuru⟧。
examples.english: Whether or not to accept this proposal will be decided at a future meeting.

examples.japanese: {数十人|すうじゅうにん}、{否|いな}、{数百人|すうひゃくにん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧、{否|いな}、⟦ほぼ→ほぼ：00109_hobo⟧⟦{不可能|ふかのう}→不可能：03144_fukanou⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}える→言う：00515_iu⟧だろう。
examples.english: It could be called difficult — or rather, nearly impossible.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れた→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧だった。{否|いな}、⟦{傑作|けっさく}→傑作：00217_kessaku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧べきものだった。
examples.english: It was an excellent work. Nay, it was what should be called a masterpiece.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 commonly appears in the pattern ～⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧{否|いな}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ (whether or not ~), which is formal and used in written Japanese. In compounds like ⟦{賛否|さんぴ}→賛否：14233_sanpi⟧ (pros and cons) and ⟦{安否|あんぴ}→安否：16157_anpi⟧ (safety/well-being), {否|ひ} is read with its on'yomi. Sense 2 is literary and rhetorical, used to correct or strengthen a previous statement.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧{否|いな}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: whether or not ~
- {否|いな}、～: nay, rather ~

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{賛否|さんぴ}→賛否：14233_sanpi⟧: pros and cons, for and against
- ⟦{安否|あんぴ}→安否：16157_anpi⟧: safety, well-being
- ⟦{可否|かひ}→可否：16151_kahi⟧: propriety, approval or rejection
- ⟦{否定|ひてい}→否定：03707_hitei⟧: denial, negation

SIMILAR WORDS:
{否|いな} is literary. The casual equivalent for "no" is ⟦いいえ→いいえ：02845_iie⟧ or いや. The related entry ⟦{否|いや}→否：01920_iya⟧ (no, reluctance) has a different nuance, expressing dislike or refusal.
